Dear Mayor Quimby and Mr. Skinner,

We, the undersigned, hereby submit a petition to address the environmental degradation caused by the Springfield Nuclear Power Plant. The plant's operations have led to the contamination of the Springfield River, posing a significant threat to the health and well-being of our community. We urge you to take immediate action to shut down the plant and implement stricter regulations on nuclear waste disposal. Furthermore, we request that the city invest in renewable energy sources to reduce our reliance on nuclear power. We believe that it is our responsibility to protect the environment for future generations, and we hope that you will join us in this effort. Thank you for your attention to this matter. Sincerely, Lisa Simpson
